purpose: Fresh-start hypothesis: short-horizon continuation after a momentum/catalyst day accrues OVERNIGHT (close T -> open T+1), while the following intraday session is flat-to-negative. Buy the strongest catalyst names at the close, sell at or shortly after the next open.
discovery_evidence_already_seen: explore_overnight_decomp.py on 2024-09..2026-09 (2,700 names): big-catalyst days (gap>=8%, vol>=3x, green) overnight excess +0.64% [+0.05,+1.24] n=504, next-session intraday +0.02%, 5-day -1.25%; gap-up-held overnight +0.19%, intraday -0.22%; top-20-by-return-with-volume overnight +0.08%, intraday -0.04%. These two years are therefore DISCOVERY and may not be reused as evidence.

holdout.data: bars1d_10y (yfinance daily, same symbol list; survivorship caveat: delisted names absent, bias direction discussed in the report)

events_at_close_T.E1_big_catalyst: gap = Open_T/Close_{T-1}-1 >= 0.08 AND Volume_T >= 3 x mean(Volume_{T-20..T-1}) AND Close_T > Open_T
events_at_close_T.E2_gapup_held: gap >= 0.03 AND Close_T >= Open_T AND Volume_T >= 2 x ADV20sh
events_at_close_T.E3_strong_close: Close_T/Close_{T-1}-1 >= 0.03 AND (Close_T-Low_T)/(High_T-Low_T) >= 0.8 AND Volume_T >= 2 x ADV20sh
events_at_close_T.E4_top20_ret_vol: among names with Volume_T >= 2 x ADV20sh, the 20 highest Close_T/Close_{T-1}-1 that day

trades.X1_overnight: buy at Close_T x (1+0.0005); sell at Open_{T+1} x (1-0.0005)
trades.X2_next_close: buy at Close_T x (1+0.0005); sell at Close_{T+1} x (1-0.0005)

benchmark: SPY over the identical leg (Open_{T+1}/Close_T - 1, or Close_{T+1}/Close_T - 1); metric = mean excess return per trade (%), also raw
statistics: quarter-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (>=1000 reps); share of quarters positive; n; per-capital series with K=5 equal-weight positions (20% each) filled first by E1 then by day return, max drawdown; yearly table

pass_criteria_holdout.multiple_testing: Holm across the 8 cells (4 events x 2 exits)

not_allowed: changing thresholds after seeing holdout results
adding events or exits after seeing holdout results
using Volume_T or Close_T information for T's universe filter
expected_failure_modes: overnight edge concentrated in one regime (2020-21 retail boom)
costs and overnight gap risk larger for small names
survivorship in the 10-year symbol list inflating gap-up follow-through
